resources.string: A black screen, broken pictures, no sound: say it in one line. It goes to the XRecomp developers with the last game\'s log and its last events, once you have seen what is sent and chosen Send.
The game\'s picture, shown below before anything leaves
No picture of the game to add
Sent only if you choose Send: your line, the game\'s log and its last events (no names, only what was done), without folders, addresses or links. No game data, no account, no e-mail.
A game is running: use Report a problem in its menu.
Plays 60 s without touching the controls, then shows the frame rate. Nothing is sent unless you choose Send.
No save state: the game restarts and is measured from boot
Benchmark: 60 s, hands off the controls
Benchmark: no figures (the game did not run)
Send gives the developers this result: the frame times, the game\'s key and console, the device, Android and app version. No name, no game data.
